hero.title: A church anchored in the gospel.
hero.text: We are a family in the heart of Montevideo. God's grace holds us, His Word guides us, and we walk in faith together.
hero.photoAlt: The church community gathered under the trees

lines: God @crown did not stay far away.
He came near in Jesus Christ, @cross
*and became the steady anchor of our faith.

doctrines.title: WHAT WE BELIEVE
doctrines.intro: Nine truths that hold our faith and shape how we live each day.
doctrines.quote: “Always be prepared to give an answer to everyone who asks you to give the reason for the hope that you have.”
doctrines.closing: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

together.title: Many ways to serve, one body that grows.
together.text: We see service as a path of growth: in every ministry we build each other up as one body.
